meta.title: Qaima QR — Digital menus & WhatsApp ordering for restaurants
meta.description: Scan-to-open digital menu for Egyptian restaurants and cafés. Guests scan the table card and order on WhatsApp in seconds. Plans from EGP 99/month.

landing.title: Your menu, one scan away
landing.tagline: A digital menu your guests open by scanning the card on the table — with sizes, add-ons and WhatsApp ordering built in.

features.title: Everything your menu needs
features.subtitle: From the first scan to the last order — built for restaurants and cafés across Egypt.

0.title: Instant QR menu
0.description: Guests scan the card on the table and your menu opens instantly — no app, no signup.

1.title: WhatsApp ordering
1.description: Orders arrive as ready-to-send WhatsApp messages with table number, sizes and add-ons.

2.title: Sizes & add-ons
2.description: Offer dish sizes, spice levels and extras, each with its own price.

3.title: Always up to date
3.description: Change a price, hide a sold-out dish or add tonight's special in seconds.

4.title: Printable table cards
4.description: Generate and print a QR tent card for every table with one click.

5.title: Menu analytics
5.description: See which dishes guests view and order the most, day by day.

steps.title: Up and running in one day
steps.subtitle: No hardware, no staff training, no waiting.

0.title: Send us your menu
0.description: Photos or a PDF are enough — we build your digital menu for you.

1.title: Put the cards on the tables
1.description: Print the QR tent cards we generate for each of your tables.

2.title: Start taking orders
2.description: Guests scan, pick their dishes, and the order lands on your WhatsApp.
